title: Closed immersions are finite
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then $i$ is finite, i.e. $i$ is affine and $i_*\mathcal O_Z$ is a finite $\mathcal O_X$-algebra.
